messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Perform a digital microfluidic homogeneous enzyme assay suite using alkaline phosphatase (AP) and fluorescein diphosphate (FDP). First, run a basic assay: dispense 1 unit of AP and 1 unit of FDP, mix for 15s, read fluorescence for 1m, and dispose. Next, perform substrate quantitation by repeating this process 5 times using standard FDP droplets. Then, monitor enzyme kinetics: mix 1 unit of AP and 1 unit of FDP for 15s, and measure fluorescence in a loop for 10 iterations of 30s each, then dispose. Finally, conduct enzyme inhibition assays with inorganic phosphate (Pi): For a 10 uM FDP baseline, mix AP and FDP with 0, 15, 30, and 45 uM of Pi (where applicable, pre-mix FDP and Pi for 15s before adding AP for 15s) and monitor each reaction for 5 iterations of 30s. Repeat this exact 4-stage inhibition sequence using a 5 uM FDP baseline. Dispose of all mixtures after their respective measurements.
